        cw.wsstate AS worksite_state,
        p.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'level' AS wage_level,
        SUBSTR(c.beginday, 7, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(c.beginday, 4, 2) AS start_month
    FROM cases c
    LEFT JOIN case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
    LEFT JOIN prevailing_wage p ON p.trackno = cw.wagetrack
    WHERE c.homefirm = 'Microsoft Corporation'
),
case_volumes AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE
            WHEN COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY start_month) = 1 THEN '1'
            WHEN COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY start_month) BETWEEN 2 AND 4 THEN '2-4'
            WHEN COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY start_month) BETWEEN 5 AND 14 THEN '5-14'
            ELSE '15+'
        END AS monthly_volume_band
    FROM case_details
),
ranked_rules AS (
    SELECT
        v.filekey,
        v.start_month,
        v.headct,
        COALESCE(r.base_hours, 3.50) AS base_hours,
        COALESCE(r.position_hours, 0.50) AS position_hours,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY v.filekey
            ORDER BY
                (r.visa_class IS NOT NULL)::INT
              + (r.wage_level IS NOT NULL)::INT
              + (r.h1b_dependent IS NOT NULL)::INT
              + (r.soc_major_group IS NOT NULL)::INT
              + (r.worksite_state IS NOT NULL)::INT
              + (r.monthly_volume_band IS NOT NULL)::INT DESC,
                r.rule_id ASC NULLS LAST
        ) AS rule_rank
    FROM case_volumes v
    LEFT JOIN review_schedule r
        ON (r.visa_class IS NULL OR r.visa_class = v.visa_class)
       AND (r.wage_level IS NULL OR r.wage_level = v.wage_level)
       AND (r.h1b_dependent IS NULL OR r.h1b_dependent = v.h1b_dependent)
       AND (r.soc_major_group IS NULL OR r.soc_major_group = v.soc_major_group)
       AND (r.worksite_state IS NULL OR r.worksite_state = v.worksite_state)
       AND (r.monthly_volume_band IS NULL OR r.monthly_volume_band = v.monthly_volume_band)
)
SELECT
    start_month,
    ROUND(SUM(base_hours + position_hours * headct), 2) AS load
FROM ranked_rules
WHERE rule_rank = 1
GROUP BY start_month
ORDER BY start_month;

                    CASE WHEN r.h1b_dependent IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +

      WHEN v.emcv = 1 THEN '1'
      WHEN v.emcv BETWEEN 2 AND 4 THEN '2-4'
      WHEN v.emcv BETWEEN 5 AND 14 THEN '5-14'
      ELSE '15+'
    END AS monthly_volume_band
  FROM cases c
  JOIN volumes v
    ON v.homefirm = c.homefirm
   AND v.start_month = date_trunc('month', strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y'))
  JOIN case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
  JOIN prevailing_wage pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
  WHERE date_trunc('month', strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y')) = DATE '2024-01-01'
),
governing AS (
  SELECT
    ca.h1b_dependent,
    ca.headct,
    COALESCE(r.base_hours, 3.50) AS base_hours,
    COALESCE(r.position_hours, 0.50) AS position_hours
  FROM case_attributes ca
  LEFT JOIN review_schedule r
    ON (r.visa_class IS NULL OR r.visa_class = ca.visa_class)
   AND (r.wage_level IS NULL OR r.wage_level = ca.wage_level)
   AND (r.h1b_dependent IS NULL OR r.h1b_dependent = ca.h1b_dependent)
   AND (r.soc_major_group IS NULL OR r.soc_major_group = ca.soc_major_group)
   AND (r.worksite_state IS NULL OR r.worksite_state = ca.worksite_state)
   AND (r.monthly_volume_band IS NULL OR r.monthly_volume_band = ca.monthly_volume_band)
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    PARTITION BY ca.filekey
    ORDER BY
      (CASE WHEN r.visa_class IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
       + CASE WHEN r.wage_level IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
       + CASE WHEN r.h1b_dependent IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
       + CASE WHEN r.soc_major_group IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
       + CASE WHEN r.worksite_state IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
       + CASE WHEN r.monthly_volume_band IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC,
      r.rule_id ASC
  ) = 1
)
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(base_hours + position_hours * headct)
        FILTER (WHERE h1b_dependent = 'Yes'), 2) AS avg_yes,
  ROUND(AVG(base_hours + position_hours * headct)
        FILTER (WHERE h1b_dependent = 'No'), 2) AS avg_no
FROM governing;

    CAST(replace(replace(pw.wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'from', '$', ''), ',', '') AS DOUBLE)
      * CASE pw.wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'unit'
          WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080 WHEN 'Week' THEN 52

        END AS apw

  GROUP BY w.homefirm
```sql
)
```

        (CASE WHEN cr.customer_segment IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE WHEN cr.return_channel IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE WHEN cr.item_category IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE WHEN cr.primary_reason IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE WHEN cr.item_condition IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE WHEN cr.min_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL
                  OR cr.max_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC,
        cr.rule_id ASC
    ) AS rn
  FROM main.returns r
  JOIN main.orders o ON o.txnnum = r.srctxn

    AND (cr.primary_reason IS NULL

    AND (cr.item_condition IS NULL
         OR cr.item_condition = (q.assessment_summary->>'$.condition.item_condition'))
    AND (cr.min_monthly_returns IS NULL OR m.cmrc >= cr.min_monthly_returns)
    AND (cr.max_monthly_returns IS NULL OR m.cmrc <= cr.max_monthly_returns)
  WHERE o.buyerlink = 'CUS00032'
    AND substr(r.revdate, 1, 7) = '2025-01'
```sql
)
```

    SELECT
        r.casenum,
        r.revdate,
        r.return_channel,
        r.return_details,
        c.seg_category,
        p.itemcategory,
        CAST(p.unit_value AS DOUBLE) AS unit_value,
        q.assessment_summary,
        COUNT(*) OVER (
            PARTITION BY o.buyerlink, substr(r.revdate, 1, 7)
        ) AS cmrc
    FROM main.returns r
    JOIN main.orders o ON o.txnnum = r.srctxn
    LEFT JOIN main.customers c ON c.profilenum = o.buyerlink
    JOIN main.products p ON p.itemcode = r.itemlink
    LEFT JOIN main.quality_assessment q ON q.inspectref = r.casenum
),
matching AS (
    SELECT
        b.casenum,
        cr.rule_id,
        cr.flat_charge,
        cr.charge_pct,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY b.casenum
            ORDER BY
                (CASE WHEN cr.customer_segment IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                 + CASE WHEN cr.return_channel IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                 + CASE WHEN cr.item_category IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                 + CASE WHEN cr.primary_reason IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                 + CASE WHEN cr.item_condition IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                 + CASE WHEN cr.min_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL
                              OR cr.max_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL
                        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC,
                cr.rule_id ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM return_base b
    JOIN main.return_charge_rules cr ON
        (cr.customer_segment IS NULL OR cr.customer_segment = b.seg_category)
        AND (cr.return_channel IS NULL OR cr.return_channel = b.return_channel)
        AND (cr.item_category IS NULL OR cr.item_category = b.itemcategory)
        AND (cr.primary_reason IS NULL OR cr.primary_reason = (b.return_details->>'$.reasoning.primary_reason'))
        AND (cr.item_condition IS NULL OR cr.item_condition = (b.assessment_summary->>'$.condition.item_condition'))
        AND (cr.min_monthly_returns IS NULL OR b.cmrc >= cr.min_monthly_returns)
        AND (cr.max_monthly_returns IS NULL OR b.cmrc <= cr.max_monthly_returns)
),
charges AS (
    SELECT
        b.revdate,
        m.rule_id,
        (CASE WHEN m.rule_id IS NULL THEN 15.00 ELSE m.flat_charge END
         + CASE WHEN m.rule_id IS NULL THEN 5.0 ELSE m.charge_pct END
           / 100.0 * b.unit_value) AS rhc
    FROM return_base b
    LEFT JOIN matching m ON m.casenum = b.casenum AND m.rn = 1
)
SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(rhc) FILTER (WHERE rule_id IS NULL) / SUM(rhc),
    2
) AS standard_share_pct
FROM charges
WHERE revdate >= '2025-01-01'
  AND revdate < '2026-01-01';

        q.assessment_summary->'condition'->>'item_condition' AS item_condition,
        COUNT(*) OVER (
            PARTITION BY o.buyerlink, LEFT(r.revdate, 7)
        ) AS cmrc
    FROM returns r
    JOIN orders o ON o.txnnum = r.srctxn
    LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.profilenum = o.buyerlink
    JOIN products p ON p.itemcode = r.itemlink
    LEFT JOIN quality_assessment q ON q.inspectref = r.casenum
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        b.casenum,
        b.revdate,
        b.unit_value,
        rr.rule_id,
        rr.flat_charge,
        rr.charge_pct,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY b.casenum
            ORDER BY
                (
                    (rr.customer_segment IS NOT NULL)::INT
                    + (rr.return_channel IS NOT NULL)::INT
                    + (rr.item_category IS NOT NULL)::INT
                    + (rr.primary_reason IS NOT NULL)::INT
                    + (rr.item_condition IS NOT NULL)::INT
                    + (rr.min_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL
                       OR rr.max_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL)::INT
                ) DESC,
                rr.rule_id ASC NULLS LAST
        ) AS rn
    FROM base b
    LEFT JOIN return_charge_rules rr
        ON (rr.customer_segment IS NULL OR rr.customer_segment = b.seg_category)
       AND (rr.return_channel IS NULL OR rr.return_channel = b.return_channel)
       AND (rr.item_category IS NULL OR rr.item_category = b.itemcategory)
       AND (rr.primary_reason IS NULL OR rr.primary_reason = b.primary_reason)
       AND (rr.item_condition IS NULL OR rr.item_condition = b.item_condition)
       AND (rr.min_monthly_returns IS NULL OR rr.min_monthly_returns <= b.cmrc)
       AND (rr.max_monthly_returns IS NULL OR rr.max_monthly_returns >= b.cmrc)
),
charged AS (
    SELECT
        rule_id,
        COALESCE(flat_charge, 15.00)
            + COALESCE(charge_pct, 5.0) / 100.0 * unit_value AS rhc
    FROM ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
      AND revdate >= '2025-01-01'
      AND revdate < '2026-01-01'
)
SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(rhc) FILTER (WHERE rule_id IS NULL) / SUM(rhc),
    2
) AS standard_share_pct
FROM charged;

Customer Return Months graded Severe account for **30.47%** of total Return Value Leakage in 2025.

```sql
WITH cm AS (
  SELECT
    o.buyerlink AS cust,
    substr(r.revdate, 1, 7) AS mon,
    SUM(
      CAST(p.unit_value AS DOUBLE)
      - CAST(p.unit_value AS DOUBLE)
        * CAST(q.assessment_summary->>'$.results.aesthetic_score' AS DOUBLE) / 10.0
        * CASE (q.assessment_summary->>'$.condition.completeness')
            WHEN 'Complete' THEN 1.00
            WHEN 'Accessories Missing' THEN 0.85
            WHEN 'Missing Parts' THEN 0.60
          END
      + CAST(r.return_details->>'$.shipping.fee' AS DOUBLE)
    ) AS sum_rvl,
    SUM(CAST(p.unit_value AS DOUBLE)) AS sum_v
  FROM main.returns r
  JOIN main.orders o ON o.txnnum = r.srctxn
  JOIN main.products p ON p.itemcode = r.itemlink
  JOIN main.quality_assessment q ON q.inspectref = r.casenum
  WHERE substr(r.revdate, 1, 4) = '2025'
  GROUP BY o.buyerlink, substr(r.revdate, 1, 7)
),
graded AS (
  SELECT
    sum_rvl,
    CASE
      WHEN sum_rvl / sum_v < 0.55 THEN 'Contained'
      WHEN sum_rvl / sum_v < 0.70 THEN 'Elevated'
      ELSE 'Severe'
    END AS leakage_class
  FROM cm
)
SELECT ROUND(
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN leakage_class = 'Severe' THEN sum_rvl ELSE 0 END)
  / SUM(sum_rvl),
  2
) AS severe_share_pct
FROM graded;
```

```sql
SELECT ROUND(SUM(ws.settle_fee + ws.settle_cover_pct / 100.0 * ws.replcost), 2) AS settlement_usd
FROM (
  WITH snap AS (
    SELECT r.snapkey, r.snapts, COALESCE(m.makertag, 'Unlisted') AS maker_group,
           m.makertag, m.pnlkind, a.alrtstate, p.warrstate,
           CASE
             WHEN p.cap_mw < 100 THEN 'Small'
             WHEN p.cap_mw < 300 THEN 'Mid'
             WHEN p.cap_mw >= 300 THEN 'Large'
           END AS cap_band,
           COUNT(r.snapkey) OVER (
             PARTITION BY COALESCE(m.makertag, 'Unlisted'), date_trunc('month', r.snapts)
           ) AS claim_volume,
           COALESCE(o.replcost, 0) AS replcost
    FROM main.plant_record r
    JOIN main.plants p ON r.sitetie = p.sitekey
    JOIN main.panel_models m ON p.modhook = m.modkey
    LEFT JOIN main.alert a ON a.snapalrt = r.snapkey
    LEFT JOIN main.operational_metrics o ON o.snapops = r.snapkey
  ), tiered AS (
    SELECT snap.snapkey, snap.snapts, snap.maker_group, snap.makertag, snap.pnlkind,
           snap.alrtstate, snap.warrstate, snap.cap_band, snap.claim_volume, snap.replcost,
           CASE
             WHEN snap.claim_volume = 1 THEN 'Single'
             WHEN snap.claim_volume <= 3 THEN 'Moderate'
             ELSE 'Bulk'
           END AS vol_tier
    FROM snap
  ), ranked AS (
    SELECT t.snapkey, w.rule_id, w.fixed_fee_usd, w.cover_pct,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
             PARTITION BY t.snapkey
             ORDER BY
               (CASE WHEN w.maker_tag IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                + CASE WHEN w.pnl_kind IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                + CASE WHEN w.alrt_state IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                + CASE WHEN w.warr_state IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                + CASE WHEN w.cap_band IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                + CASE WHEN w.vol_tier IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC,
               w.rule_id
           ) AS rn
    FROM tiered t
    JOIN main.warranty_settle_rules w
      ON (w.maker_tag IS NULL OR w.maker_tag = t.makertag)
     AND (w.pnl_kind IS NULL OR w.pnl_kind = t.pnlkind)
     AND (w.alrt_state IS NULL OR w.alrt_state = t.alrtstate)
     AND (w.warr_state IS NULL OR w.warr_state = t.warrstate)
     AND (w.cap_band IS NULL OR w.cap_band = t.cap_band)
     AND (w.vol_tier IS NULL OR w.vol_tier = t.vol_tier)
  )
  SELECT t.snapkey, t.snapts, t.maker_group, t.makertag, t.pnlkind, t.alrtstate,
         t.warrstate, t.cap_band, t.claim_volume, t.vol_tier, t.replcost, g.rule_id,

         COALESCE(g.cover_pct, 5.00) AS settle_cover_pct
  FROM tiered t
```

```sql
        ) AS monthly_volume
```

```sql
WITH snapshots AS (
    SELECT
        r.snapkey,
```
```sql
        date_trunc('month', r.snapts) AS month_start,
        m.makertag,
        m.pnlkind,
        p.warrstate,
        a.alrtstate,
        CASE
            WHEN p.cap_mw < 100 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN p.cap_mw < 300 THEN 'Mid'
            WHEN p.cap_mw >= 300 THEN 'Large'
        END AS cap_band,
        o.replcost,
        COUNT(*) OVER (
            PARTITION BY date_trunc('month', r.snapts),
                         COALESCE(m.makertag, 'Unlisted')
        ) AS monthly_volume
    FROM plant_record r
    LEFT JOIN plants p ON r.sitetie = p.sitekey
    LEFT JOIN panel_models m ON p.modhook = m.modkey
    LEFT JOIN alert a ON r.snapkey = a.snapalrt
    LEFT JOIN operational_metrics o ON r.snapkey = o.snapops
),
tiered AS (
    SELECT *,
        CASE
            WHEN monthly_volume = 1 THEN 'Single'
            WHEN monthly_volume IN (2, 3) THEN 'Moderate'
            ELSE 'Bulk'
        END AS vol_tier
    FROM snapshots
)
SELECT
    strftime(t.month_start, '%Y-%m') AS month,
    t.vol_tier,
    CAST(ROUND(SUM(
        CASE WHEN w.rule_id IS NULL THEN 300.00 ELSE w.fixed_fee_usd END
        + (CASE WHEN w.rule_id IS NULL THEN 5.00 ELSE w.cover_pct END)
          / 100.0 * COALESCE(t.replcost, 0)
    ), 2) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS settlement_usd
FROM tiered t
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT rule_id, fixed_fee_usd, cover_pct
    FROM warranty_settle_rules wr
    WHERE (wr.maker_tag IS NULL OR wr.maker_tag = t.makertag)
      AND (wr.pnl_kind IS NULL OR wr.pnl_kind = t.pnlkind)
      AND (wr.alrt_state IS NULL OR wr.alrt_state = t.alrtstate)
      AND (wr.warr_state IS NULL OR wr.warr_state = t.warrstate)
      AND (wr.cap_band IS NULL OR wr.cap_band = t.cap_band)
      AND (wr.vol_tier IS NULL OR wr.vol_tier = t.vol_tier)
    ORDER BY
        (CAST(wr.maker_tag IS NOT NULL AS INTEGER)
         + CAST(wr.pnl_kind IS NOT NULL AS INTEGER)
```

**32.31%** of total Technology Recoverable Energy in 2020 came from technology-months in the Severe Energy Loss Band.

```sql
WITH snapshots AS (
  SELECT
    m.pnlkind,
    strftime(r.snapts, '%Y-%m') AS month,
    (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'energy_yield'->>'energy_yield_kwh')::DOUBLE
      / NULLIF(
          ((e.elec_perf_snapshot->'energy_yield'->>'availability_pct')::DOUBLE / 100)
          * (1 - (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'efficiency'->>'soil_loss_pct')::DOUBLE / 100),
          0
        ) AS potential_kwh,
    (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'energy_yield'->>'energy_yield_kwh')::DOUBLE
      / NULLIF(
          ((e.elec_perf_snapshot->'energy_yield'->>'availability_pct')::DOUBLE / 100)
          * (1 - (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'efficiency'->>'soil_loss_pct')::DOUBLE / 100),
          0
        )
      - (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'energy_yield'->>'energy_yield_kwh')::DOUBLE AS loss_kwh
  FROM main.plant_record r
  JOIN main.plants p ON r.sitetie = p.sitekey
  JOIN main.panel_models m ON p.modhook = m.modkey
  JOIN main.electrical_performance e ON e.snaplink = r.snapkey
  WHERE r.snapts >= DATE '2020-01-01'
    AND r.snapts < DATE '2021-01-01'
),
technology_months AS (
  SELECT
    pnlkind,
    month,
    SUM(loss_kwh) AS recoverable_kwh,
    100 * SUM(loss_kwh) / NULLIF(SUM(potential_kwh), 0) AS r
  FROM snapshots
```

```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) AS case_count
FROM main.cases c
JOIN (
  WITH ca AS (
    SELECT
      c2.filekey,
      CAST(c2.visacls AS TEXT) AS visa_class,
      pw2.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'level' AS wage_level,

      substr(c2.soccd, 1, 2) AS soc_major_group,
      cw2.wsstate AS worksite_state,
      CASE
        WHEN v.emcv = 1 THEN '1'
        WHEN v.emcv BETWEEN 2 AND 4 THEN '2-4'
        WHEN v.emcv BETWEEN 5 AND 14 THEN '5-14'
        ELSE '15+'
      END AS monthly_volume_band
    FROM main.cases c2
    JOIN main.case_worksite cw2 ON cw2.dockkey = c2.filekey
    JOIN main.prevailing_wage pw2 ON pw2.trackno = cw2.wagetrack
    JOIN (
      SELECT
        homefirm,
        date_trunc('month', strptime(beginday, '%d/%m/%Y')) AS start_month,
        COUNT(*) AS emcv
      FROM main.cases
      GROUP BY 1, 2
    ) v
      ON v.homefirm = c2.homefirm
     AND v.start_month = date_trunc('month', strptime(c2.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y'))
  )
  SELECT
    ca.filekey,
    COALESCE(r.base_hours, 3.50) AS base_hours,
    COALESCE(r.position_hours, 0.50) AS position_hours
  FROM ca
  LEFT JOIN main.review_schedule r
    ON (r.visa_class IS NULL OR r.visa_class = ca.visa_class)
   AND (r.wage_level IS NULL OR r.wage_level = ca.wage_level)
   AND (r.h1b_dependent IS NULL OR r.h1b_dependent = ca.h1b_dependent)
   AND (r.soc_major_group IS NULL OR r.soc_major_group = ca.soc_major_group)
   AND (r.worksite_state IS NULL OR r.worksite_state = ca.worksite_state)
   AND (r.monthly_volume_band IS NULL OR r.monthly_volume_band = ca.monthly_volume_band)
  QUALIFY row_number() OVER (
    PARTITION BY ca.filekey
    ORDER BY
      (CASE WHEN r.visa_class IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
       + CASE WHEN r.wage_level IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
       + CASE WHEN r.h1b_dependent IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
       + CASE WHEN r.soc_major_group IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
       + CASE WHEN r.worksite_state IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
       + CASE WHEN r.monthly_volume_band IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC,
      r.rule_id ASC
  ) = 1
) g ON g.filekey = c.filekey
WHERE date_trunc('month', strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y')) = DATE '2023-12-01'
  AND g.base_hours + g.position_hours * c.headct > 5.00
```
